digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md — close workflow documentation
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit, when the implementation (_referencing_commit_exists) scans git log with no ref against HEAD's entire reachable history, accepting any commit (merged or local) referencing the ticket or any transitive descendant
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact and completion-verification gate state, not unconditional as documented; it also exits early on --force-close or live replacement links

AGENTS.md never mentions rebar transition --ref, which is the documented way to close a stacked story against its own commit while the worktree stays at the epic tip; --ref retargets verification and signature, not the referencing-commit scan
The actual ordering rule enforcing land-before-close is the Verified +1 policy (AGENTS.md:233-234), not the precheck mechanism, yet the docs imply the precheck enforces the ordering
